This proves controller selection, argument/state order and consumed return contracts, not those deep algorithms or framebuffer pixels. Semantic fixtures explicitly vary piece sizes/type/selector; separate startup profiles use exactly the independently proved1327 tuples and actual geometry. Only the12 evidenced class stores are reconstructed; unrelated C++ constructor state is outside this boundary.

Actual toolbar selection and complete construction gameplay are not claimed.

Controlled region and mask/clip mutations additionally exercise mode and occupancy reloads, including the later29..2B variant and second-pass live-actor arm. These mutation fixtures establish boundary effects, not an assertion that the current deep algorithms perform those writes. Valid map indices, size0..6 and even orientation0/2/4/6 are used for the main/member controllers; direct projection additionally checks untouched outputs on unsupported orientations.
